title: Architect an evidence-grounded Aria estate migration to VCF 9
prompt:
Build the migration architecture for the estate in `fixtures/estate.json`. It is a single-site consolidated VMware Cloud Foundation design that must remain viable at the four-host minimum while moving the inventoried VMware Aria Operations, VMware Aria Automation, and VMware Aria Operations for Logs deployments to VCF Operations, VCF Automation, and VCF Operations for Logs and carrying forward compatible content.

Before implementing, use your network research tools to make genuine live fetches from at least two distinct, real, reachable HTTPS pages published by Broadcom on `broadcom.com` or `vmware.com` hosts. Research the supported migration or upgrade path for every exact source and target version, content and configuration compatibility or loss, prerequisites and sequencing, and the applicable end-of-general-support boundary. Do not rely on search snippets alone. Record what you actually consulted in `research/consulted.json` as a JSON array of objects with `title`, `url`, `accessed_on` in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, and a nonempty `facts` string array. Your searches and source choices are yours; no particular query or URL is prescribed. If a current page differs from the protected compatibility snapshot, record the difference, but use the snapshot as the implementation authority for this exercise.

Implement `vcf_migration` as a Python 3.11 standard-library-only package. Its CLI must run as:

`python3 -m vcf_migration --inventory fixtures/estate.json --snapshot spec/compatibility-snapshot.json --spec spec/installer-spec.json --output migration-plan.json`

The CLI must read those inputs and deterministically write `migration-plan.json`. That artifact must validate against `artifact_schema` in `spec/installer-spec.json` and express an architecture, not a prose explanation. Include the exact source product names and versions, each target component and version, the supported path, the end-of-support boundary, every inventoried content/configuration item's carry-forward or abandonment disposition, and the ordered execution steps with the gates and exit evidence for each step. The target architecture must state the four-host consolidated placement, node roles and sizing, anti-affinity failure domain, and aggregate management-component capacity. Do not add third-party dependencies. Do not edit `.protected/**`, `fixtures/**`, `spec/**`, or `pyproject.toml`.

Run `python3 -B .protected/verify.py`.
scenario: A four-host single-site consolidated estate must migrate three Aria management products and their content to the VCF 9 management components through supported, sequenced paths.
constraint: The architecture implementation is governed by the protected fixture, compatibility snapshot, and installer specification; live research must use genuine reachable sources and be recorded in the requested artifact.
